option_relations.rationale: Pyoderma with Staphylococcus simulans is a bacterial skin infection caused by Staphylococcus simulans. Tularemia is a bacterial infection caused by Francisella tularensis. These are distinct diseases with different etiologies.

Staphylococcal skin infection is a broad category of bacterial infections caused by Staphylococcus species. Tularemia is a specific bacterial infection caused by Francisella tularensis. They are not related.
Staphylococcal infection refers to any infection caused by Staphylococcus bacteria. Tularemia is caused by Francisella tularensis, not Staphylococcus. Therefore, they are unrelated.

Staphylococcal bullous infection (e.g., bullous impetigo) is a specific type of skin infection caused by Staphylococcus aureus. Tularemia is caused by Francisella tularensis and presents differently. These are distinct conditions.
